notes.title: Meet Kacerie, the Stylist
notes.content: [h2][b]Kacerie, Elegant Survivor[/b][/h2][p]Kacerie looks mostly human, except for her natural neon pink hair. Not fitting in at first, you will win her heart if you can show how well you can take care of her.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/91cdfa23ddcc555b381b80c7b28db7198d944bd8.png"][/img]Pink-haired and sassy, she only really wants one thing: to not die on this dino-infested planet. And who can blame her?[/p][p]Kacerie is skilled in hairdressing and cosmetics, and she’ll be in charge of making sure your fort truly feels like a home. [/p][p]In a pinch, she can channel raw energy into her hands, storing up to two devastating Lance Strikes at a time. Each blast unleashes a focused beam of destruction with precision and style. After firing them, she needs 14 full days to recharge, and that’s when she’ll need your help the most![/p][h3]Usually impeccably dressed, occasionally not dressed at all[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/67cce323380986b4114a7746437f4518a57f00ef.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Bust: [/b]83cm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Waist:[/b] 51cm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hips:[/b] 83cm[/p][/*][/list][p]Beautiful, elegant, and irresistibly hot. Win her heart, and she might just let you see the breathtaking body hiding beneath that adorable outfit.[/p][h3]Advanced Technology and Elegance[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/01d009803b9362f848189a5354a1b15a9cc2c43d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/31d99b0b5f7e5f442f19f487fa5f566ed9b563c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Interests:[/p][list][*][p]Not dying in the wilderness[/p][/*][*][p]A passion for bringing out the beauty in people and the world around her[/p][/*][*][p]Eye Contact and Deep Thrusts[/p][/*][/list][p]Are you willing to risk it all to have her?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Tamer: King of Dinosaurs NOW![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #09 - Early Demo Out, Demo Feedback, Look-at Tech, and more!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]It has been a long road, filled with hiccups and eureka moments, and we’re proud of what we’ve achieved so far. We can’t wait to show you what the future holds for [b]Tamer: King of Dinosaurs[/b]![/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/"][/dynamiclink][b]Early Demo Out[/b][/h2][p]Let’s start with the most important thing: our early demo is now available to our supporters! You can see how to get it on our [b]Discord server[/b]![/p][p]The demo consists of three parts: Galmine’s romance scene with its sex module and outro animation, and the cutscene demo preview:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Day 1 Chase Sequence[/b][/h3][p]This is the very first gameplay section of Tamer, where Victor meets Hope and they work together to escape some hungry deinonychus. We've included a preview video with this post so you can see what you'll be playing soon![/p][p]We've overlayed audio from our non-combat theme for now, as the gameplay triggers for SFX are still being worked on. We also did a recent recording session with the voice of Victor himself to include some new lines![/p][p]This really helps to elevate the experience and make it feel natural.[/p][p]In particular, this chase includes a lancing segment where Victor will use his spear to end some predators that try to dismount him. You can also experience the jump/duck system we use in our chases here.[/p][p]We're looking for lots of feedback here, so let us know what you think when you get to play it![/p][p][/p][h3][b]NSFW System Demo[/b][/h3][p]This will essentially be an updated version of the original Galmine NSFW demo.[/p][p]So what has changed? First off, the lighting is vastly improved, as well as the camera system. We've also added a new map, and the voice samples of the characters have been expanded.[/p][p]You'll definitely see and feel a difference here.[/p][p]We will be expanding this part of the demo more as development continues. Expect to see an additional character and map next month![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cutscene Preview[/b][/h3][p]Finally, we have a cutscene preview. Lots of people have asked us if Tamer's cutscenes are in-engine or pre-rendered, and the answer is, of course, in-engine! There is not a single second of pre-rendered footage in Tamer, and we're very proud of that.[/p][p]This is being included so people can see how it performs on their machine while it is not fully optimized. We'll be doing an optimization pass later, so we're checking to see how far to go with that.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Overall Feedback[/b][/h2][p]We were happy to hear everyone was impressed by the demo! Positive feedback was directed towards the visuals, the energy and presentation of the chase sequence, the writing and character development of the cutscene, and the improvements in the NSFW content.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Upcoming Changes[/b][/h2][p]However, we did receive some excellent feedback that some features could use some improvements. Thankfully, these were all things we were already discussing, and we had potential solutions lined up.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dino Lancing[/b][/h3][p]The sections of the map where you lance deinonychus with your spear don't have clear visual indicators that allow you to understand how to properly time your attack. Additionally, the controls were unclear.[/p][p]We have thrown out the old indicator and replaced it with a target that hovers on the dino like the old one, but is easier to see. In addition, two arrows on the left and right collapse inward at a consistent pace to show when to activate your weapon to score a successful hit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/8a6b671047cc969d2027713e3aa61a0b7bffa0e8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Obstacle QTE Indicator[/b][/h3][p]While everyone expressed it jumping and ducking on the parasaur was smooth and simple to understand, it was noted that every obstacle has the same setup and can therefore feel repetitive.[/p][p]We've adjusted this by making it so the "success" section of the indicator is on the top if you're jumping and on the bottom if you're ducking. This slightly changes the time and action and feels more natural.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/b0dd16cd2c672ebcce73c7e715b9531ea28f5808.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]NSFW Content Interaction[/b][/h3][p]This has been requested since our first demo dropped earlier this year, and it's something we still want to explore. With our combat system in full swing, along with finishing the NSFW animation itself, it will take some time, but we'll do our best to add more interactive elements to the love scenes as we get closer to launch, such as hand position, spanking, grabbing, etc.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Carnotaurus Warnings[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wUa0j0ySjKk"][/dynamiclink]This week's cutscene preview is from right after Victor and Sheela escape the carnotaurus. Note that, as usual, this is pre-alpha, so there are some animations and many other aspects like VFX that are still in progress.[/p][p]Day 8 is when this narrative break occurs, right after the epic chase sequence. At this point, Victor has won over Trel, Galmine, and Sheela, and they're actively working to build the fort. Trel also starts to really help the group, although whether she's motivated by the goodness in her heart or the need for Victor's insemination remains up for debate.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Trel's NSFW Preview[/b][/h2][p]Now that Kacerie's animations are wrapped, we're working on Trel's romance scenes. Since Victor is less experienced and Trel is more dominant, her early encounters have a different flavor from the later ones, as shown in the preview image below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/c43f417ff98412dddcf6e21ad55896f5f00debf9.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]
Book Promos[/b][/h2][p]We're making some more promo content for the game and book series, so we've started posing the girls for a few lovely pinup shots of them enjoying some good literature.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/ff5cab1c1a9e025441f5b78fb8f8b6fda3eb9b95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Look-at Tech[/b][/h2][p]An important part of achieving immersion with games like this is having functional look-at tech, which means the character's eyes appropriately engage with the environment and the characters around them.[/p][p]We now have this up and running, and it makes things so much more alive. It's often subtle touches like these that bring games from A to AA level, and that's definitely what we want to strive for with this production - something that shows we actually care about every level detail.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/3f8fa4e19abe1458c190ff459e0f74e4e3e0c5ac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2][p]Right now, we're working on adding subtitles to all the scenes. First, we need to add the text, and then we'll clean up the presentation so they're not so scrunched.[/p][p]This process will also give us a shot at localization for several key regions, like China.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/379d5346da9593433c02f4fd51fd18cfa6d62c6d.png"][/img][/p][p]Our next major objective is two separate sequences where Victor and Sheela fight against the orange birds from Hope's back in an effort to cull their numbers before they can overrun the cave, while the fort isn't ready yet.[/p][p]We already have a prototype up and running, and construction is underway![/p][p]It's likely that as soon as it's finished that we will add this to the demo build and release it for our Patreons to play.[/p][p]We're also doing some LOD upgrades to the map to bring it up to more modern standards.[/p][p]You can see some key areas we're focusing on in the image below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/fa0939c0b83da0ea2154c4a886a0fdee5c5b90c4.png"][/img][/p][p]See you next month with more good news![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/e398e43554520621978d31168149a63850d7d8d2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Meet Sheela, the Huntress
notes.content: [h2][b]Sheela, Pride Warrior[/b][/h2][p]Sheela is a stoic huntress, brave and beautiful, bound by her culture. The best hunter among her people, possibly of her world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/6cdfacd027647bc77333cece9e47259147704f41.png"][/img]Versatile, strong, and gorgeous. Whether you want to hunt, train, or mate, she is the one.[/p][p]Prove you're strong enough to free her from her loveless arranged marriage, and she'll be yours forever.[/p][h3]Tame Sheela… and enjoy her every inch[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/c0d4e0a2595542e68e0f5f6c89a302b5954f57ab.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Bust: [/b]102cm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Waist:[/b] 59cm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hips:[/b] 100cm[/p][/*][/list][p]With a slim and fit 40/23/39 body, used to hunting and fighting, Sheela will always be up to "help" you... Do you think you can handle this amount of stamina?[/p][h3]When beauty and power collides[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/069204de409f6b75526c6e425c9ef2235d4a89f5.png"][/img][/p][p]Interests:[/p][list][*][p]Fighting and hunting[/p][/*][*][p]True love[/p][/*][*][p]Mating[/p][/*][/list][p]Will you let this Cheetah-girl guide you?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Tamer: King of Dinosaurs NOW![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #08 - Supporters Build, Animations, Boob Physics, and more!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We have tons of exciting news to share with you! Now hold tight, because this will be a long one.[/p][p]And before we get to it, don’t forget to wishlist [b]Tamer: King of Dinosaurs[/b]![/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/"][/dynamiclink][b]Supporters Demo Build[/b][/h2][p]As we mentioned a few times already, we are currently putting together material for a new demo build for our supporters. We're shooting for the end of August at this point, so you guys can see how far the development has come.[/p][p]Here's what the demo will include:[/p][list][*][p]Updated Galmine NSFW scene with new lighting and physics[/p][/*][*][p]Chase sequence (first time we've given access to gameplay!)[/p][/*][*][p]Additional preview cutscenes delivered in-engine[/p][/*][/list][p]Once this demo is released, we plan to update it over time by adding additional NSFW content and polishing the gameplay based on your feedback.[/p][h2][b]Day 1 Chase Continues[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/c87f1f834762910706fd5f89d9a3f62707d4512f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Development on the cave chase is progressing well, but we've been working on this one for a month straight and need a break. As a result, we're going to focus more on cutscenes for now, but we'll be back with more news about it soon![/p][h2][b]Romance Scenes and Animations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Trel's Hotspring Scene[/b][/h3][p]Recently, we started working on the opening cutscene of Trel's final romance quest.[/p][p]This one involves a trip to the hot springs so she can take a bath. Here is a preview shot for you, but keep in mind these are censored since she has her dress on, and in the full game, she's gonna be in her birthday suit.[/p][p]Also, the purple hair is a result of some lights not being properly set up yet. Maybe we can consider it as a cosmetic option in the future, “a happy accident”.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/835856853388a82f9d83409636d3f98e57a2d465.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Trel's NSFW Animations[/b][/h3][p]Speaking of Trel, her NSFW scenes are in the works, and these are particularly tricky because of all the extra anatomy we have to deal with to get her functional.[/p][p]The results look great, though, especially in motion! We hope to include her in an upcoming demo build exclusive to our supporters once she's ready.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/dc9aeac2d860fc96f1a9cd94a892ca7e6a8d9a80.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Sheela Romance Scene[/b][/h3][p]Mild spoiler here, but Sheela's first romance scene is a special one. It takes place after a rather monumental effort on Victor's part to keep her safe.[/p][p]The weather on this day called for us to create a new VFX setup that was tricky because it takes place inside our cinematic version of the fort. This has an "artificial" sky, and replacing it with anything this heavy takes some doing.[/p][p]Still, we pulled it off! Here's the result:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/695537d0c3f37a70b802fdc42f8507f4b9641117.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Upcoming Sheela's Lake Scene Preview[/b][/h3][p]Soon, we should have a preview for you of a certain scene that happens at the lake between Victor and Sheela that sets the tone for their relationship in our devlog.[/p][p]This sequence was particularly challenging because of the VFX work and the water particles needed to show Sheela taking a cat bath...a very sexy one at that.[/p][p]We know you'll enjoy it, so give us another week to clean it up a bit, and we'll have it available for your viewing pleasure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/419d3aa9255f11539a06a065139c403b65bed014.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Final Kacerie Positions[/b][/h3][p]Our NSFW animator is finishing up Kacerie's sequences. Here's a particularly good-looking standing doggy sequence set up in the gemstone cave, and a few positions:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/aaabea65ab1cfea25b1792689a3424d6e782c09c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/0a19511731a960373ef11abfbceb15c7a5a921b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/8b0e66692a6a2170df522a85bf251cd3e4280fa5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Galmine NSFW Animations[/b][/h3][p]We also have some spicy Galmine previews for you![/p][p]Take a look at her in action during her third romance quest in the harvest grove below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/48d092dc79ca5ac98eaaf99cf707b10900bf942c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/26e80129a9c12ce81b421dd4b5c729ff46e2ab87.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Heel Adjustments[/b][/h2][p]Along with completing NSFW animations, we're also working on getting all of the high heels working with our outfit system, which is proving to be trickier than expected, but the results speak for themselves.[/p][p]So if you wanted to smash in massive stripper heels, don't worry - we've got you covered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/4bc7697bc1373af3777c2cd3fec537a1774df53c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]NSFW Outfit Boob Physics[/b][/h2][p]Great, glorious science has blessed us with micro bikinis and boobs that react realistically to them. Oh Lord...[/p][p]Check out Sheela practicing her stretches below, and see Victor stretching Sheela below as well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/7a43e4b682edbf7fb8213e26a89e46a89f5eee6f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/550bee4f840fa6e09618b6d4c286be03eb133ee8.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll be able to take full advantage of these outfits in our romance scenes.[/p][p]We also wanted to assure everyone that these outfits will be available during gameplay as well, so you can have your favorite ladies wearing your favorite outfits at all times.[/p][p]They will also carry over to cutscenes, which we're sure will result in some stepped-on dramatic moments when someone's pouring their heart out in a barely visible plastic string suit.[/p][h2][b]Cutscene Updates & VFX[/b][/h2][p]As we go through the cutscenes and get them ready for launch, we also apply VFX. In this case, we added an indicator to our characters whenever they access their [i]Eye-Q[/i].[/p][p]You can see Sheela teaching Victor how to use his below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/35d0c3d7a05e72537eee94fe1bbdf39fa95a689c.png"][/img][/p][p]Something else we've been doing recently is refactoring some of the scenes we prepared for trailers previously to fully function in the engine on the correct project settings, such as the shot below with shadowplay:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/e69b8852f57659fd5b726fb6c67856cb880bc285.png"][/img][/p][p]Not that it's too amazing to look at, but this effect with the curtain was something that took some doing:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/2b429a3a160ebecf2807b13cba9f486be59edfbb.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Performance Dubbing[/b][/h2][p]An unfortunate part of recording a game this massive is the fact that sometimes, things just don't work. Characters are out of position, you have sync issues, and other things that can't be fixed with manual animation adjustments, etc.[/p][p]That's why we need to "dub" some sequences with new animation from professionals to make sure the scenes hit the way they need to.[/p][p]We've also added additional characters in the background in some shots that were originally intended only to have one male and one female, and this has proven an excellent method to elevate the scenes.[/p][p]Luckily, this has proven to be relatively simple compared to how we thought it would go.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/6b37d18615e0a18e0d7325218eaa49fe5d9c22b5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/5ec3219f33e6c1b9a500961a41333659ca2fec4a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Promo Material Creation[/b][/h2][p]Finally, please enjoy these lovely pictures of Sheela and Kacerie being posed for promo images.[/p][p]We'll be using this pose for posters and other items to show the game off online.[/p][p]Expect to see these flying around the net soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/5350af1d788de901704b8761b6b3ac6dcc1a8b2a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2][p]Keep an eye out for the upcoming 'Meet the Girls' posts, which we should still have this upcoming month! We’ll keep working hard to bring you even more updates on our monthly development journey![/p]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #07 - Chase Gameplay, NSFW Scenes, Combat Design, and more!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We got so many updates to share with you that we were having trouble not spoiling them.[/p][p]And before we get to it, don’t forget to wishlist [b]Tamer: King of Dinosaurs[/b]![/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3][b]Day 1 Chase Setup[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S7o34HUMW9U"][/dynamiclink]In this clip, we can take a look at the first segment of gameplay of the project overall: just like in the books, Victor runs for his life from a pack of deinonychus through the jungle. However, this time around, we've changed up the plot in a significant way so that he meets Hope, his first parasaur mount, right off the bat.[/p][p]They work together to survive the situation and then go their separate ways as Victor has not mastered, nor is he even aware, of his power yet.[/p][p]It's an interesting narrative change that opens the door for some great new scenes.[/p][p]Keep in mind we are still in pre-alpha visualization at this point, and everything is incredibly rough, but this should give you an idea of the overall concept and the pacing we're aiming for.[/p][p]This serves as a tutorial to teach you how to lance dinos with your spear and dodge, duck, dip, dive, and dodge.[/p][p]One thing we've added to this map is obstacles on the ground that do damage if you run over them, such as the spiked brambles.[/p][p]We've also added deinonychus lancing, where they will approach you from the front or side, and you must use your spear to attack them, and this must be manually aimed. This part is still a work in progress, but we should have it done within the next two weeks.[/p][p]The empty section in the middle is where we plan to have a big "vista" moment where you can look out at the world and see some large dinosaurs, such as brachiosaurus, roaming in the background.[/p][p]After that, inside the cave, we're going to have some beautiful crystals fall from the ceiling and work as impact obstacles.[/p][p]You can see a preview of it in the following video:[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TYLihs9Lxgc"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3][b]NSFW Lighting Underway[/b][/h3][p]Now that we have finished the first lighting pass of the cinematics, we've begun adding lighting to the NSFW scenes. Our technical artists took great care in upgrading the options available there and made it look much better.[/p][p]We've still got some color grading and VFX work to do, but check out the progress below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/aa8ca825e12dbda2b3b3df1c8e70daadc260c2f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/29cb2f96cc574e4c49a0e140c05b4a062396f2f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/7caf274fa168c2796833302cec43b489c8cb0a84.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Victor Outfit[/b][/h3][p]Since Victor gets into a lot of scraps during his first month in Dinosaurland and his work shirt gets wrecked, we needed a new outfit for him.[/p][p]We designed something that he could wear underneath that would eventually replace his main outfit towards the middle of the game. Using a simple tank top base, we designed a logo for the LA County Dept of Animal Care and Control and applied that PNG to the 3D model.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/d3470bf963ea9c9cfe39e62cb4700b4f0382a381.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Map Progress[/b][/h3][p]We're continuing to work on the map as always, and recently made a pass over a key area you'll visit on day 10 prior to the deinonychus raid at the fort.[/p][p]This is where you'll battle a deinonychus alpha for the first time.[/p][p]We needed this area to have room for the battle while also looking good for cutscenes. We're going to tweak the colors more here so the grass isn't so yellow, but you get the idea.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/0b545cb7741a8329db22aa42cc7cf5d4d4abd70f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat Design - Adrenaline[/b][/h3][p]As we continue designing combat, we looked at other melee-focused games in the genre and examined concepts we liked and ones we felt did not fit our project.[/p][p]In particular, stamina meters are something the team as a whole did not find particularly fun. In games where they exist, combat is seen more as something hardcore and punishing, where players rely on heavy, calculated swings to take advantage of openings and do damage while constraining themselves from becoming too vulnerable.[/p][p]While this works well for those projects, we want Tamer to be focused more on fun, arcade-style combat that can still be challenging without relying so heavily on pacing and windows of opportunity.[/p][p]To that end, we've decided to reward players for playing well in the opposite way - when you land a solid hit, parry, counter, dodge properly, etc., you will earn adrenaline. This charges up like a super meter in a fighting game.[/p][p]As you earn adrenaline, you can either maintain it for passive bonuses or expend it using special moves, like a mana bar that refills with solid gameplay decisions and execution.[/p][p]We're still working out the details, but we're really enjoying this concept so far.[/p][p]We'll explain more about combat and progression as time goes on and we begin implementing these ideas.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Pachycephalosaurus Animation[/b][/h3][p]We've finally confirmed that the pacy will be a regular enemy in the game and have rigged and started animating it for a debut very soon.[/p][p]These guys are going to be tough late-game enemies that attack in groups with some interesting patterns that need to be dodged and countered by the player.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/efe454003eff29a5406c721c13a3af40d5d78ce3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]Keep an eye out for the upcoming 'Meet the Girls' posts, which we should still have this month! We’ll keep working hard to bring you even more updates on our monthly development journey![/p]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #6 – Romance, Chase Scenes & Dino Combat Heat Up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been quite some time since the last dev blog, so we are bringing up the pace again. We hope you look forward to the next ones!

Don't forget to wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/


[h2]Galmine Romance & Valley Chase[/h2]

Today we wanted to show you two video previews of what we've been cooking up lately.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8CeK3gVubrQ

The first is Galmine's second romance scene. Here she offers to make Victor some larger water pots for the fort but needs better materials to do it. That leads them inside an area that's a natural pheonomenon and absolutely beautiful.

Since this is their second time together, their conversation about their relationship is more confident and in-depth. They reveal some intimate truths to each other and you learn about their characters through the interaction, which is exactly what this game is all about - not just shoving sex in your face, but presenting it as a natural sum of real, loving relationships.

The second part of the video is a preview of the chase scene in the valley.

This is still in PRE-ALPHA, so please excuse the animations and timing. It's rough at the moment but gives you a good idea of what to expect from Tamer's high-octance action sequences.

[h2]ADDITIONAL CUTSCENE WORK[/h2]

Along with the romance scenes we're now wrapping up production on some additional sequences that take place in the valley. Now that we've done some more set dressing for this area the cinematography is turning out great.

We've got basic lighting in place and plan to enhance the visuals even more as we get closer to launch.

Our approach to blocking these scenes is to try and take the "every frame a painting" philosophy to heart and not just have the camera tipping all over the place like many modern game and film productions.

This allows you to really focus on the character's expressions and the excellent story without feeling too drab or boring. Adding subtle movement to the cameras keeps you connected to the frame while offering a bit more visual stimulation than a totally still shot.

We're happy with how this footage is turning out and will be sharing more as we move forward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/8101152168b7e9a1cb525a158e6200f65897a30e.png[/img]

Now that we have animatons for Jinx, even he's getting in on the action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/f4d4943af3bd34647f1d97729fbe6b206c466112.png[/img]

[h2]DINO ANIMATION[/h2]

With the cleanup of the human characters 90% finished we can now focus our attention on the dinos and give them some love. Here you see Victor taming Hope - his first dinosaur mount.

They share a moment of deep connection through his taming ability here and she becomes loyal for the rest of the game.

Animating these sequences are tricky because we have to animate the dinosaurs and manipulate the performance capture at the same time, but getting to the finished product is rewarding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/94ea65506ce02b94c2a4200872be95a2d6ba7f54.png[/img]

[h2]COMBAT SYSTEM DOCUMENTATION
[/h2]

We're making sure to create plenty of solid documentation as we get ready to start implementing the core parts of our combat system. Doing so will allow us to produce something stable and effective.

Here you can see the aggro system for the enemies in place.

Since we are going to have Victor and Sheela fighting multiple dinosaurs, we need to make sure they don't get totally swarmed and overwhelmed. Adding an intended rhythm and balance to combat is essential to avoid this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/4c38452d5ad37711f93c09d93c498b983b8edb26.png[/img]

Therefore we're creating our own take on the kind of ticket system used by so many modern games to ensure enemies can both act and think as a group. This allows them to store actions without immediately taking them and instead doind what they need to at the right time so everything feels good rather than random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/8216368629a807634dc13beb0520bddc36b04ddc.png[/img]

[h2]NEXT ENEMY - Pachycephalosaurus[/h2]

One of the new enemy types we're going to add to the game is the pachy you see above. They will be highly mobile and aggressive enemies that chase you if you try to avoid them. They attack with charging patterns and short range headbutts but are vulnerable to everything but a direct attack.

That means parrying or doding their approach will yield significant openings for damage.

Expect to see them up and running within the next few months.

[h2]KACERIE NSFW PREVIEWS[/h2]

Kacerie's big romance scene is still in development and here you can see her practicing some partner yoga with Victor.

This is the first time we've tried some 69 action and we'll show you how good it looks in-engine soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/6f387fddcfd4c7b4dd73d12ff968ffa4cf107bb0.png[/img]

I'll just leave this here also...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/30cf79a1c0790bd923d94cb03e8124008f3dac26.png[/img]

[h2]MAP DETAILS[/h2]

Now that the gameplay and days are all sorted we can add some higher detail passes to the map. You can see the process yielding some great results below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/72a5e78fa1d357ffbb33259b33f334d1524073b0.png[/img]

Of course, this is not totally final. We'll have a lot more to add and tweak before release, especially concerning lighting and atmosphere.


See you in the next dev update!


- [i]Ride the Lion Studios[/i]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #5
notes.content:
Hello fans!

Today we have a preview of a fun cutscene we just started working on this week. Here you can see the first time Sheela brings Victor to the peak of Dinosaurland and shows him what's up. We had to make a special landscape version just for this one sequence but it sure paid off.

Note that this is still a WIP as you can see from the spears being at the wrong angles at times and the look of the water at the lake. That's because we've got all new water in the game!

[b]NEW WATER[/b]

We've had a placeholder volume in place for the game's water for quite some time.

We've now put some work in to upgrade it and the map is looking way better as a result.

It not only makes an impact on the cinematography but also the general vibe of the gameplay. Once we add some nice ambient water sounds as well the world will feel more alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/42e878b90e777a243f22b384c17ca76a878bbbb0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/a480d92fd07012233f62d62081edc98d8086891d.jpg[/img]

[b]BIRD FIGHT[/b]

On the 6th and 9th days of the game you have an encounter with the orange birds. This involves Victor fighting them with a spear while Sheela shoots them down one by one.

We wanted to offer some variety in this mode so we created three different colors/sizes of bird with yellow being the smallest, orange being regular and the darker ones being more mature with the biggest size and higher HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/36d19d35c39deda3f869bebd1535a7a98ecb95ba.jpg[/img]

You can see a preview of this mode on our test map below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/65bc701b370bd5e1cf601ccb2e38768a4a31daee.jpg[/img]

We consider this a raid sequence as it involves waves of enemies coming at you that need to be cleared. We're planning to add some mini-game style elements to it as well later such as dodging air attacks from the birds.

Making the pelagornis have unique attacks that take advantage of their wings even after they've been shot down has been a priority for us and we're getting that done now too.

[b]KACERIE NSFW PREVIEW[/b]

We're still chipping away at "the pink one" and her scenes in the NSFW module. Here you can see two of her new animations in engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/e7bc412bcca016838a311344836507dc696d952c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/43f8f95df39bc05a2b3a2616e1d090c16fa00533.jpg[/img]

We'll show some more off on the new NSFW maps once they're ready.

[b]HUMANOID ANIMATIONS[/b]

Another big part of production lately has been working on all of the humanoid animations we need for the game, such as bow and spear attacks. This has been a long time coming, but we finally managed to bring some help on board to get them done.

Adding these to the game will finally give it a "real" game feel rather than having everything be pre-alpha placeholders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/dbe41a6354ef95a1dfe44aae18bce6fdf0128569.jpg[/img]

[b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b]

Next week we'll have another cutscene preview you for you and some more information about our upcoming internal build test. [url=https://www.patreon.com/RidetheLionStudios]Make sure you check out our Patreon for news.[/url]

There will also be more NSFW previews as we continue working on Kacerie's scenes.

Thanks for your support! See you again next time.

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #4
notes.content:
Hello fans!

Our monthly update was a bit delayed by the holiday. We hope you all had a great season.

[previewyoutube=ZoA2PUFSWaA;full][/previewyoutube]


We're almost finished with the new romance map which we've been calling the "Onyx Forest." So who will you enjoy some quality time with in this area?

That would be Sheela, of course.

This is actually her second romance quest, and it's one of the more interesting ones in the game. Sheela approaches Victor and asks her to make a special weapon - something that can handle large dinosaurs.

Victor agrees to help, and this leads to them going on some good old hunting rounds together so they can get the materials necessary to make it.

We've mentioned this before, but Sheela is unique in that her romance quests involve combat, where the other girls do not. Her third quest in particular involves some serious deadly predators, and we'll be showing that off sometime early next year when the map is finished.

Also, here's the area of the map that leads into the onyx forest:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/dafbc961171c7cb17904d64c8926c684fb4702fb.jpg[/img]

And two more areas that have received a significant amount of work lately:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/4158f32d8e5623880c2a6228ea2622563af6ef96.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/d3a048678040f091e041a097322f4ff15cd277ba.png[/img]

[b]UPCOMING ROMANCE MAP[/b]

So what's next for the romance maps? That would be the harvest grove! We're not even going to try to hide it - this one is for Galmine.

We'll talk more about what the quest entails once it is nearing completion.

For now, please enjoy this excellent concept art! Can you guess what the plot is about from the picture alone? Let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/77e31e31861dc48e44081b3c21ea7f98907e03e8.jpg[/img]

[b]ALPHA TESTING[/b]

We're happy to announce that Tamer is already fully testable in a pre-alpha state and that we'll be upgrading to alpha by the end of the year!

The first alpha build will be tested internally. Once we have a good handle on everything, we'll be recruiting testers for the next iterations and getting general feedback on the game.

Below you can see the upgraded race module in action. We'll likely have a video showing this off next week.

You know, it's funny...the whole racing concept came about when we started doing the first few tests and realized that riding dinos actually felt really awesome and we wanted it to be a significant part of the gameplay.

Now it's one of our favorite aspects of the project!

We're all big Mario Kart fans and we think you'll feel and enjoy the similarity between how the dinos control and how smooth and casually satisfying it can be, especially the boost system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/30b8ac431f68600c89d4dd67909460ccd9e1218d.png[/img]

[b]SHEELA ROMANCE[/b]

We talked about Sheela's second romance scene in this post, but the first one is shaping up to be one of the best! Right now we're cleaning up the animation for the post-NSFW sequence, which is really touching and reveals a lot about Sheela and Victor's relationship.

Our actors absolutely knocked it out of the park!

Here you can see the shoot in real life:

 And here's how it translated to 3D. As you can see, we have some cleanup to do to get them together and holding hands. FYI - making characters hold hands in animation is a massive pain in the ass, but the actor's insisted we have that extra layer of intimacy for this scene and they were 100% right!

Well worth it, and it will show in the final product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/8360398b6f39b4e6c1d0f293f4b50a9845baa192.png[/img]

 
[b]KACERIE NSFW TEASE[/b]


Here is a picture of Victor doing some reverse cooch-muching on the eager Kacerie. Not much else to say about it...we're working on "the pink one" and her scenes now and finding it to be a lot of fun.

We'll post some NSFW preview videos on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mq379Rc475]Discord server[/url] soon!

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bPOGRawVhEg;full][/previewyoutube]

We'd like to give a warm welcome back to the general public! Since this is the first update of the month, it will be available to everyone.

For those that support us on Patreon, you know that last week we discussed putting together an updated trailer for YouTube that will allow us to dodge the adults-only tag. This black mark unforunately destroys us when it comes to the algorithm and made the trailer very hard to find and display.

Apparently YouTube doesn't like sexy spider-women talking about being inseminated or horny cat girls straddling our protagonist in front of a fire, so we're going to replace both of those sequences.

One will be of Trel standing up on her legs Doctor Octopus style and intimidating Victor during their first meeting. The other will be Sheela standing solo in the jungle looking sexy.

Here's a very rough, unlit preview of the Sheela sequence:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/806631fb6b2cc60f5b8cb2997ea67451826b3735.jpg[/img]

Those abs...my god.

The updated trailer is expected to hit early next week, so we'll post it for everyone as soon as it's uploaded. Then there will likely be a separate update post at the end of the week exclusive to our Patreons.

[b]GALMINE POLL WINNING OUTFIT[/b]

One of the perks of being a Ride the Lion Patreon is getting to vote on our sexy outfit polls! As you can see in the video and from the preview pics below, we've completed Galmine's most recent outfit and it turned out really damn good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/d0d2a6b79172f4611a9e8517618e6a22ee70ff96.jpg[/img]

We're currently doing some revisions to Kacerie's model, so once that's ready we'll have an outfit poll for her to celebrate!

[b]BIRDERMIC TECH[/b]

Also featured in the video is a simple but important environment tech that we've developed. It allows us to give the appearance of having many birds on the screen without severely impacting performance by actually having a ton of 3D models in action.

For those that have read the books you know that this is key because the pelagornis, aka the orange birds, are a menacing presence faced by the tribe all throughout the first book.

You'll fight them several times to defend the cave while your fort is being cosntructed, so this tech gives us the opportunity to make them even more intimidating. We can also control the speed and density of this effect, so we can get exactly the feel we want.

[b]3D TO CONCEPT[/b]

Right now we have the entire map constructed in 3D and fully traversable by our actors. However, we still don't have a 100% clear idea of how we want it to look. That means we benefit greatly before making the detail pass by having a solid concept artist show us the potential of these piles of polygons.

What we do is take a video and many screenshots of the important areas and pass it on to our artist, like the one below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/c016645fd90d1bafd367d75f049ed8b58edc2c38.jpg[/img]

Then they come back to us with an awesome concept like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/458e0485e1578190b99f5646e46376045a7e1e1f.jpg[/img]

This gives us exactly what we need to add the necessary details. We'll show you an updated comparison once we finish the detail pass on the map, but this will happen later down the line when we look to upgrade from alpha to beta.

[b]PROLOGUE ANIMATION[/b]

If you've read the Tamer books (and if you haven't, [url=https://michaelscottearle.com/collections/tamer-kod/products/tamer-book-1]you can get the first one for free...SO WHY HAVEN'T YOU?[/url]) then you know all about the epic pool party with Victor on Earth.

You can also see exactly how it looks in the Tamer Visual Novel, which is available on YouTube for free.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDFS34bALI1RU00tk8zr8UOv5EPu_jRYw]Here's a playlist of all the current visual novel videos![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/3cd6c79fec7d00b2199ea0b8d85636c29f4d9a07.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/dc4daa0e6c2837425207bc0906606ae8defd1f3f.png[/img]

As soon as the studio finished reading the books we began to discuss if it was viable to recreate this Earth sequence in 3D. We quickly came to conclusion that while we really wanted to do it, it would take a ton of additional assets like over a dozen hot babes in bikinis.

This would be a massive resouce sink and didn't include any actual gameplay or romance scenes, so we decided to pass on it.

This also extended to Victor's arrival on Dinosaurland after the initial alien abduction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/1c76e3b2820799d44c0760627aafa0e97547bc79.png[/img]

Here he meets shark-man-warrior Heracula and military monkey bro Sergent Kelg right before they get into a big scrap with some deinonychus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/2502b3cce9aa13ea673ec619c2c6f5f2857351d4.png[/img]

Since we already have some excellent 2D art and an amazingly talented animator that is happy to work with us, we decided to repurpose these visual novel assets and create an awesome 2.5D parallax animation to kick off Tamer!

This will not only look awesome, it will massively cut down on the runtime before players get to the actual game. We didn't want everyone sitting through 45 minutes of cutscenes, so we know this will be the best solution to get the critical prologue information across while still setting a good pace.

And since we have the actual VN available, players still have the option of watching the full introduction on YouTube.

We're going to try and finish this before the end of the year, but it might get postponed until Q1 2024 depending on how production goes and what requires our attention.

[b]WHAT'S NEXT[/b]

Next week on our Patreon we'll have the new trailer for the game available. See you there!

notes.title: Monthly Dev Update #1
notes.content:
Hello fans! Welcome to our first Steam update (this is for August 2024).

[b]DEVELOPER INTERVIEW[/b]

[previewyoutube=zDVuJl-fCgM;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to give you some more inside information on not just the game's progress but how this whole thing started, and we're bringing it to you in the form of a collaboration video with one of our studio members who also happens to be a long-time YouTuber.

We were impressed with Halfpint's dedication to providing fair and solid coverage of a variety of titles from the mainstream to even indie adult, so we asked him to help us provide feedback on our own project.

Little did we know at the time that he was pursuing a career in video game development himself! He proved to be a valuable asset to the studio, so we brought him on as a real team member to help out the studio management and even do level design and map work in Unreal Engine.

This is the first time the general public will be able to see an interview with the madman behind this whole thing, Michael-Scott Earle, as he talks about why he decided to turn his best-selling series, Tamer: King of Dinosaurs, into a video game as well as the progress of everything.

It's a really great, in-depth look at what it takes to make a project like this happen, so please enjoy!

We're also considering doing some future Q&A in a format like this when we have further updates to make, so please let us know what you want to hear about the game!

[b]CUTSCENE PROGRESS[/b]

We now have over half of the cutscenes in the game blocked out with cameras or posed with full sequencer timing down.

This has been a really tough process, but it's paying off!

Tamer's narrative, especially the romance with the hot alien babes, is its key selling point.

We think people are going to be blown away at the sheer volume and quality of footage we were able to produce with this game as a small indie studio. We truly feel it's impressive stuff and we're going to be sharing more with you as production continues.

[b]MAP PROGRESS[/b]

We're making more progress with the map and have started installing the VFX like atmospheric fog, which you can see here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/59190d82d53934e358f1628b27c3982bd53bdf84.jpg[/img]

The landscape is also coming together nicely. We're starting to add some smaller details and bringing cohesion to some areas.

Each area of Tamer's map is broken down into different biomes, and each one represents a different kind of gameplay and level of alert.

Below you can see the valley:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/92c2a2e075b3dab69f4e546b2fa116870114dd49.jpg[/img]

 This is where the fort and cave exists and it is the safest area in the game, generally speaking. You might have to deal with some occasional apex predators wandering in and ruining your day, but no spoilers for now.

Something else we haven't discussed yet is that our map features some nice Metroidvania-style progression when it comes to unlocking paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/49d4d5f895adbae066a27f4580f811fcaaddfd23.jpg[/img]

 Victor and Sheela can generally reach most of the early map on their own, but you will occasionally reach areas with things like fallen logs and brambles that need to be cleared to progress.

So how do you do it? By taming dinosaurs, of course! As you tame larger and larger dinosaurs, you'll be able to break through these barriers and open up much larger areas with greater challenges and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055015/df6a7f9e8b9a0ab573a6932860fce3a789b3c9c9.jpg[/img]

 Something else to note is that some paths are simply too narrow for some dinosaurs. When you encounter these, you'll need to go ahead on foot. This is a tough decision to make because there are some seriously dangerous dinosaurs out there.

Not having access to a mount to run away could cause fatal outcomes if you're not ready to fight, but this is part of the excitement of the game! The map should feel like a real pre-historic jungle with danger lurking around every corner, and that's how we want the player to feel when they choose to enter these areas.
